headlines: Testbed experiments harden ROS 2 robots and connected vehicles against network attacks
reason: These studies evaluate vehicle tracking, device integrity and road safety. Each reports a different outcome under a different test design. Their results do not support one joint performance claim.

headlines: Simulation studies bound how AI data center workload flexibility translates into grid support
reason: The three studies estimate different quantities. They examine how much load the grid can accommodate, whether a facility can serve its workload within local electrical limits, and how well a controller limits fluctuations. The first two studies share two exact author names.

headlines: Simulated pursuit-evasion control: safety and capture guarantees, planning vs capability
Simulation-only pursuit-evasion work pairs formal capture and safety proofs with capability limits
reason: The authors analyze three different outcomes in abstract mathematical models. One work establishes conditions for a theoretical result, one evaluates collision avoidance, and one compares simulations. The three studies do not test a common performance claim.

headlines: Simulated AI workload coordination cuts interconnection needs and grid costs
reason: One study estimates the extra grid connection capacity required by a factory. A second models network operating cost and a third estimates a computing operator’s electricity bill. They supply evidence for three different decisions. One grid simulation uses measured GPU serving curves as inputs.
